benchmark: Hard scenarios excluded from every reported benchmark metric and chart
qwen_reporting_label: Qwen3:4b, no thinking; source identifiers retained in provenance
accuracy: Within each model/combination, With Store=(v15+v16)/2 and No Store=(v1+v2)/2; then equal mean over 16 combinations. GraphRAG=v1 only. Both variants required. Failed extractions count as incorrect.
accuracy_sd: Sample SD (ddof=1) of prompt-averaged combination accuracies, NOT SD of prompt rows, run SD, SE or confidence interval. Overall SD across 80 model/combination observations; model SD across 16; scenario SD across 20.
other_metrics: Primary shared complete-case support: GraphRAG v1, With Store v16, No Store v1. Separate per-system and prompt coverage in metric_coverage.csv and metric_summaries.csv. No imputation; absent and undefined cells listed explicitly.
metric_sd: Sample SD (ddof=1) across retained per-combination metric values, recomputed from those values. Not a pooled turn metric or run uncertainty.
raw_score_sd: Raw-score variance and SD kept per combination/prompt; never averaged into benchmark SD. Historical per-combination raw-score SDs are available. Pooled historical run-accuracy SD is not reconstructed here; reconstruction from summary moments would require verified historical turns per run. GraphRAG run SD recomputed from per-run observations; pooled scenario/run spread includes task heterogeneity.
calibration: GraphRAG: correctness versus decision_prob, missing-only mean_answer_prob fallback. Pool valid-confidence turns within each combination then macro-average combination metrics. ECE uses 3 bins. Historical confidence denominators unavailable.
undefined_afr: Historical AFR zero placeholders where EFR=1 are marked undefined: no extracted answers. Audit in undefined_afr_audit.csv; primary AFR shared support 74/80 cells.
undefined_word_means: Historical TPCA zero placeholders are converted to missing for accuracy=0 correct-response groups or accuracy=1 incorrect-response groups. Original values in undefined_word_means_audit.csv. Per-system/shared supports consequently differ; never interpret an empty group as a zero-word response.
experimental_differences: Qwen GraphRAG=qwen3:4b with think=False; historical=hoangquan456/qwen3-nothink:4b. Shared display label does not establish checkpoint equivalence.
GraphRAG uses supplied targets, snapshot history, sampled paraphrases, scenario_seed=0, domain-dependency-v2 retriever, response_cache=False, temperature=0, 10 runs and 10 turns/run/combination.

Historical single-agent summaries have temperature=0 and 10 runs, but no per-turn records, run lengths, seeds or verified matching questions/history/settings; historical baseline prompt versions are inferred by normalizer.
GraphRAG num_predict=768, num_ctx=8162, keep_alive=10m. Historical matching settings cannot be verified from summaries.
Supplemental v16_one_shot remains a separate experiment. Hard and temporal-noise experiments outside the 16-combination benchmark are excluded.

Evidence/fidelity labels unavailable for GraphRAG; no GraphRAG elapsed time. Historical timing is parallel-batch time, not isolated latency. Auxiliary/EMD conditions repaired in memory from evaluator semantics.
Separate experiments permit descriptive comparisons, not causal or paired significance claims.
execution: Existing CSVs only; no evaluations or model calls. Run notebooks from repository root.
